audience: authors and publishers who sell printed books or products through Peecho

useCases.title: Find a print product for a book
useCases.text: List the product categories and their sub-category codes. Then list the offerings under one code, with paper type and minimum quantity.

useCases.title: Price a print run before you order
useCases.text: List the countries an offering ships to. Request a quote for the items and destination. A quote returns prices and shipping and creates no order.

useCases.title: Size the cover spine for a page count
useCases.text: Calculate the spine width of an offering for a page count and country. For an existing order, read the spine width of each item.

useCases.title: Check the status of an order
useCases.text: Read an order's state, prices, shipping address and items. Use the state to see whether the order is still open.

useCases.title: Create an order and add its print files
useCases.text: Create an open print order with one item per file, each with a unique item reference. Then set the print file URL for each item. Pay for the order in the Peecho dashboard.

useCases.title: Correct the shipping address of an order
useCases.text: Replace the customer email and shipping address on an open order. Read the order first to confirm its state and items.
